name: Shin Tai Industry Co., Ltd.
summary: Shin Tai Industry Co., Ltd., a Taiwanese enterprise founded in 1972 and based in Kaohsiung, specializes in the production and supply of a diverse array of animal nutrition products. The company's portfolio includes a range of aquaculture feeds, marketed under its "Golden" brand, which cater to species such as tiger prawns, eels (including floating varieties), milkfish, tilapia, and cobia. Additionally, Shin Tai formulates feed for various other animals, including poultry (chickens and ducks), livestock (pigs and cattle), and companion animals (dogs). Beyond its domestic presence in Taiwan, the firm also distributes its products internationally, exporting to markets in Mainland China, as well as numerous countries across Southeast and South Asia.
